name: Armenian Center for Contemporary Experimental Art (ACCEA/NPAK)
known: Founded by Sonia Balassanian, Edward Balassanian and Arne Z.
A biography of Edward Balassanian on the centre's site says he and Sonia Balassanian co-founded it in 1995.
Council chairs named include Joan Agajanian Quinn (1999, 2001, 2003) and Sonia Balassanian (2005, 2009).

Edward Balassanian was Acting Executive Director of the Cafesjian Museum Foundation, one of the benefactors, from June 2002 through February 2009, and the centre's chief executive from 1992 to 2024 (ACCEA biography page).

name: Cafesjian Center for the Arts
known: Named for its founder and principal benefactor, the Armenian-American philanthropist Gerard L.

name: Modern Art Museum of Yerevan
known: Director: Nune Avetisyan (Wikipedia).
The team page lists the director and staff only.
First Soviet museum devoted to modern art; director Nune Avetisyan.

name: National Gallery of Armenia
known: Directors: Marina Hakobyan from 2020, Arman Tsaturyan 2015 to 2020, Pharaon Mirzoyan 2002 to 2015 (Wikipedia).

In January 2017 then-director Arman Tsaturyan said the building "does not comply with the international standards at all" and that the government had started a programme to build a new building; he said that if the government cannot afford it, measures to preserve the collection are still needed (Pa
In April 2019 Anna Sargsyan, director of the House Museum branch, said the building needed renovation and that its condition made preserving the exhibits difficult (Armenpress, 25 April 2019).

name: Art Gallery of South Australia
known: Jason Smith has been director since February 2025, after Rhana Devenport (2018 to 2024) (Wikipedia).

BHP is Tarnanthi's presenting partner (AGSA) and has backed it since 2015; the gallery's head of philanthropy, Vincent Ciccarello, called BHP "a resources industry rather than a fossil fuel industry" and says it tells exhibiting artists about the funding under a "continuous consent" model (InDaily).

name: Samstag Museum of Art
known: Leadership: Director Erica Green.
The board has seven members: Amanda Vanstone AO (chair), Nell, Julie Ewington, Stephanie Grose, Anna Hackett, Professor Irene Watson and Erica Green ex officio.

name: Murray Art Museum Albury
known: Blair French became chief executive in January 2024, after Bree Pickering, who was director from November 2016 to March 2023 (Wikipedia).

name: Art Gallery of Ballarat
known: The benefactor James Oddie is described as its "patron and founder", and a public association was formed in 1886 (Wikipedia).
Acquisition funds are kept separate from operating funds and both are reported publicly (stated by gallery director Louise Tegart, The Courier, 25 Jan 2022).

name: Institute of Modern Art
known: Robert Jadin de Fronenteau was the first director (Wikipedia).
Robert Leonard has been director since 2023, having also led the gallery from 2005 to 2013 (Wikipedia).

name: QAGOMA
known: Director Chris Saines kept it on display, saying the gallery defends artists' right to make challenging statements (4BC, 2 February 2021).

Board chair: philanthropist Paul Taylor, already a board member, was announced as chair on 22 July 2025, replacing Professor Emeritus Ian O'Connor, who had held the role since 2017 (Queensland Government statement).

name: Cairns Art Gallery
known: Regional public art gallery in central Cairns, Far North Queensland, run by a not-for-profit company managed by a board of directors (stated by the space).
Housed in the Public Curators Building, with plans attributed to Raymond Clare Nowland of the government architect's office, built from 1934 to 1936 (Wikipedia).
In 2026 the gallery unified the Court House Building, the Mulgrave Building and the original Public Curators Building as one precinct (Cairns Local News, June 2026).
The Public Curators Building opens Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm, Saturday 10am to 5pm and Sunday 10am to 2pm.
Mayors, councillors, state ministers, artists and residents raised more than $2 million over 15 years to convert the Public Curators Building (stated by the space).
The Cairns Art Gallery Foundation, set up in 2000 with its own volunteer board chaired by Sarah Mort, has given more than $840,000 towards 79 works by 28 artists (stated by the space).

name: National Gallery of Australia
known: Formerly the Australian National Gallery, renamed under director Betty Churcher (Wikipedia).
The Council Chair is Ryan Stokes AO; the National Gallery of Australia Foundation board includes Kerry Stokes AC and Roslyn Packer AC (annual report).

name: Darwin Festival
known: Artistic directors: Malcolm Blaylock (2003 to 2008), Jo Duffy, Edwina Lunn, Andrew Ross, Felix Preval (2017 to 2022) and Kate Fell (2023 to 2026).

name: Geelong Gallery
known: Humphrey Clegg was appointed director and CEO in 2025 (Wikipedia; annual report 2024-25).
Lists Geelong Regional Libraries as a Learn partner and ADFAS Geelong as its conservation partner.
